name: Hengan International Group Company Limited
summary: Hengan International Group Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, distributes, and sells consumer goods in China, Hong Kong, Macau, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Personal Hygiene Products, Tissue Paper Products, and Others. The company offers sanitary napkins and disposable cosmetics; baby products; adult, baby, children, and household wet wipes; and adult diapers and pull ups, leak-proof diapers, nursing pads, sanitary wipes, and other adult hygiene care products.
